أنزوي (form VII)
# أَنْزَوِي (ʔanzawī) /ʔan.za.wiː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْزَوَى (inzawā)
# أَنْزَوِيَ (ʔanzawiya) /ʔan.za.wi.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْزَوَى (inzawā)
